name: vague_tracker
title: A vague tracker ask is asked about, then drafted as a workflow page, and nothing is built

steps.say: i want to keep track of all the ai conferences happening in london this year
steps.reply: I've already found the main London AI conferences for 2026 (MLcon, The AI Summit London, AI World Congress, RE·WORK events, Big Data & AI World, and more) — I just need your answers to those three quick questions to set the list up right, then I'll draft the page for you to approve.

steps.say: It's for me; I want to decide which ones to go to; today I search by hand now and then; nothing exists yet. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply: I've drafted the page — it's on the card now. In short: a table of London AI conferences (dates, venue, website, topic, price, and your own going/maybe/skip decision), refreshed monthly from listing sites like 10times and Conference Index, with a short update on what's new or changed each time. Two things left for you to confirm on the page: whether to include past conferences too, and whether monthly auto-refresh is right or a one-time list is enough. Say yes (there or in words) and I'll build it.

checks.why: 'Track AI conferences in London' v1 is drafted: 4 steps: Find London AI conferences (alpha); Keep the list (alpha); Tell you what changed (alpha); Decide which to go to (you). Keeps london_ai_conference. 3 suggestions (0 Sherlock's): Track early-bird pricing deadlines; Tag each conference by topic; Capture price as it's published. Settings 2, questions 2.
